title: Salpicão (Brazilian chicken salad) with yoghurt
steps: Poach the chicken in lightly salted water for 15 minutes, let it cool and shred finely.
Grate the carrot, blanch the peas for 2 minutes and finely dice the apple.
Stir the yoghurt with lime juice, salt and pepper.
Mix the chicken, carrot, sweetcorn, peas, apple and parsley with the sauce and serve on lettuce leaves.
